programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Theodore helps Simon to try and get past his perfectionism in 'Artsy Smartsy', then in 'The Crush', Simon has a crush on the babysitter and secretly prepares a romantic dinner. (S4, ep 13)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Simon agrees to do whatever crazy thing Alvin wants him to do in 'Simon Says', then in 'Sing Like A Canary', a cute singing bird replaces Alvin in the band after he makes too many demands. (S4, ep 5)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Simon's experiments cause trouble when Dave asks him to declutter in 'Pack Animal', then in 'The Haunted Getaway', the boys face a haunted cabin. (S3, ep 21)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: The town is under attack when Simon creates a drone in 'Pizza Dash', then in 'Glory Days', the Chipmunks worry that they're making Dave boring when they find out he used to be a rock star. (S3, ep 17)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Dave struggles on a hike with the Chipettes in 'Girls Night Out', then in 'Tables Turned', Alvin's prank on Simon backfires. (S3, ep 14)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: The boys build a treehouse in the backyard and move out in 'Independence Day', and in 'Opposites Attract', an invention of Simon's accidently magnetizes Alvin and Simon to each other. (S3, ep 11)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Alvin regrets pranking Simon after facing payback in 'Curiosity Killed The Alvin', then in 'House Pest', Miss Croner moves in and annoys the chipmunks. (S3, ep 9)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Simon is alarmed to discover he's been tagging private property in his sleep in 'Simsky', then in 'Lucky Day', Alvin's luck goes from bad to worse after Theodore finds a four-leaf clover. (S3, ep 8)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Simon moves into a tree for some alone time in 'Back To Basics', then in 'Report Cards', Alvin worries about his bad report card and does everything to catch the mail before Dave sees it. (S3, ep 2)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Brittany and the girls release a video that Alvin, Simon, and Theodore can't top in 'Viral', and in 'Brothers of Dagarack', Simon asks Alvin and Theodore not to see a new movie without him (S2, ep 20)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Theodore struggles to do good deeds in 'Knights', and then in 'Snake Charmer', Alvin and Simon create a fake snake to help Dave get over his fear of snakes. (S2, ep 19)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Alvin encourages Simon to write a frank email in 'Un-send!', then in 'The Orb', when Simon notices that Theodore has a hard time saying no, he creates the "No-Buddy". (S2, ep 12)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Alvin begs Dave to spend a weekend alone with him in 'Alvin's Wild Weekend', then in 'For Whom the Bell Tolls', a hypnotist accidentally turns Simon into a bumbling fool! (S2, ep 8)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Simon creates a Super Hero costume for a convention he's attending in 'Munk Man', and in 'Ride Along', when Alvin's bicycle is stolen, he joins forces with Officer Dangus to solve the case. (S2, ep 7)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: When Alvin makes fun of Simon's magic act, Simon challenges him to a magic duel in 'Simon the Superb', then in 'The Sub', Alvin reluctantly signs up to teach the after school music class. (S2, ep 3)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Simon agrees to face off against Derek on a reality show in 'I Will Survive', then in 'Alvin's Got A Brand New Bag', Alvin accidentally ruins Brittany's bag and must replace it. (S1, ep 26)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Simon is too embarrassed to kiss his co-star in the school play in 'Kiss Conspiracy', then in 'House Guests', Alvin secretly decides to rent out their house for a Hawaiian home-swap. (S1, ep 20)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks

programme.title: Peppa Pig
programme.desc: Folk Music Band: Peppa and George are in Granny and Grandpa Pig's Garden. Granny's friends are playing folk music! They play music for Grandpa Pig and then Grandpa Pig makes apple juice for everyone!

programme.title: Peppa Pig
programme.desc: Hot Dry Day: Peppa and George are playing in their pool. They help the garden animals cool down but when it rains, the animals are happy and so is Peppa. Rain makes muddy puddles for jumping in!

programme.title: Peppa Pig
programme.desc: Indoor Adventure: A storm cancels Peppa and her family's adventure plans so they decide to take it inside. Using their imagination, they go sledding, climb a mountain and have a campfire in the attic.

programme.title: Peppa Pig
programme.desc: New TV: Peppa and family are watching TV... until it breaks! While Grampy Rabbit fixes it, the family get a new TV which can do everything... but it doesn't beat their old TV.

programme.title: Peppa Pig
programme.desc: Staying Up Late: Auntie, Uncle Pig and cousin Chloe are coming for dinner and Peppa is allowed to join too! Peppa is very proud of staying up late - she even stayed up later than the Daddies!

programme.title: Peppa Pig
programme.desc: Cushion Den: On a cold day, Daddy Pig suggests they build a den until Mummy Pig has finished work. After a hard day's work, the cushion den is a perfect place to watch TV together!

programme.title: Ben & Holly's Little Kingdom

programme.title: Ben & Holly's Little Kingdom

programme.title: Thomas & Friends: All Engines Go!

programme.title: Peppa Pig

programme.title: Peppa Pig

programme.title: Peppa Pig

programme.title: Peppa Pig

programme.title: Peppa Pig

programme.title: Peppa Pig

programme.title: Peppa Pig

programme.title: Peppa Pig

programme.title: Peppa Pig

programme.title: Peppa Pig
